# Hawkeye Capital

> Hawkeye Capital is a SEBI-registered mutual fund distribution practice founded in 2019 by Rajesh Sahu (ARN-156467). It offers personally managed mutual fund portfolios to clients in India and NRIs abroad — a single advisor with 30+ years in Indian stock markets, not a platform.

## Key facts

- **Legal identity:** SEBI-registered mutual fund distributor, ARN-156467
- **Founder & sole advisor:** Rajesh Sahu — Certified Financial Planner (CFP), AMFI certified
- **Founded:** 2019
- **Service area:** India (resident clients) and NRIs in the US, Europe, and elsewhere
- **Specialty:** Mutual fund distribution only — depth on funds and portfolios, not a broad product menu
- **Fees:** No direct fee to clients; revenue is distributor commission from AMCs
- **Contact:** WhatsApp +91 95401 34700
- **Portfolio tracking:** Mint by InvestWell

## Who Hawkeye works with

- Executives with liquidity events (ESOP, bonus, stake sale)
- Creatives in Bollywood, television, and media with irregular income
- Business owners and professionals in Tier 2/3 cities
- Professionals planning a career transition
- NRIs investing in Indian mutual funds (NRE/NRO accounts, FATCA-compliant)

## Regulatory

Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks; read all scheme-related documents carefully. Hawkeye Capital is a SEBI-registered mutual fund distributor (ARN-156467). Funds are held in client names with SEBI-regulated AMCs; folios are maintained by independent registrars (CAMS, KARVY).
